title: Unit Event — This Moment With You! — Episode5 What Miku Gave Me

meta.Event Outline: Leo/need's debut single is taking off. Thanks to the impact of their VIRTUAL SINGER version, their label expresses hopes that the band will create VIRTUAL SINGER versions of all future songs. But Ichika seems hesitant...

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Shiho just wouldn't budge. I didn't think she'd make us keep playing it over and over again after that.

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line:
But...
Playing together as a band was really fun.

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: Honami even said that she wanted to join the brass band or something someday.

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: We promised to do this again, so I gotta find the next song we're going to play!

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: Let's see... That video site had...

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? It's by the same person as the one we played today...!

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: That's incredible. The one we played today was really cool, but so are all these other ones...!

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: I know. I'll try listening to more of this person's songs. Let's see... I just have to click their name and...

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: Huh? What are you listening to, Ichika...?

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line:
Hatsune Miku.
I've been really into this creator's songs lately.

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line:
Wait, really...?!
I also like this person's songs.

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: Yeah! Oh, if you like their songs, then I really recommend this other person's! I hope you get a chance to check them out!

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line:
Smile Videos...?
I've never seen this site before...

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: Oh, they only upload their videos to this site! A few other people do the same thing, so I recommend that you check it out!

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: (I didn't know about this site. I'll take a closer look at it when I get home...!)

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: (This song I was recommended is really good. I think I'll try listening to more of this creator's stuff...)

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: (That reminds me of how there's supposed to be a bunch of songs only uploaded to this website...)

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line:
These words written above the video...
What are they? Tags...?

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: “Cool Miku Songs”, “Original Miku Songs”, “VIRTUAL SINGER Hall of Fame”...?

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh...!
It's giving me more videos!

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: Wow... All these songs that I've never heard of...

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. I think I'll go in order starting from the top. This is so exciting...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: After that, I learned about all these different Miku songs, and came to love you even more.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You made me want to form a band with the others, and every day became so exciting. Things became really fun...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But fun and excitement weren't the only things that you gave me, Miku...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ichika
rows.Line:
(This isn't good...
None of the songs I've listened to have helped me take my mind off of things...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ichika
rows.Line: (I was sure that Saki would be released from the hospital soon since she seemed to be feeling a lot better...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ichika
rows.Line: (But she has to stay for a little while longer. I can't imagine what she's feeling right now...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ichika
rows.Line: (Ever since we were little, she's gotten sick pretty often, but she was so excited about us all going to Miya Girls together.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ichika
rows.Line: (Shiho and Honami have also been too busy to hang out. We really haven't spoken much recently.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ichika
rows.Line: (What's going to happen to us moving forward...?)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ichika
rows.Line: Are things ever going to be like they were?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ichika
rows.Line: We'll all get back together again, right...?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ichika
rows.Line:
(This song...
It's the one Saki used to really like.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ichika
rows.Line:
(I remember how...
She said she was really drawn to the melody and Miku's voice being so gentle...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ichika
rows.Line: (It's like Miku's trying to tell me that everything is going to be okay...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ichika
rows.Line:
(Yeah, she's right...
The four of us will be friends again someday.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ichika
rows.Line: (So, for now... I should keep giving Saki all the support she needs.)
